code:
@dataclass
class ExperimentRecord:
  git_commit: str
  experiment_tag: str
  sdk_name: str; sdk_version: str
  backend_name: str
  seed_simulator: int | None
  seed_transpiler: int | None
  shots: int
  timestamp_utc: str
caption: Generated programmatically rather than typed by hand, so it can't silently drift from what actually ran.
